fact move_execution_hand_fact : forall me : MoveExecution, h : Hand . move_execution_hand(me, h) or not move_execution_hand(me, h)
fact move_execution_move_fact : forall me : MoveExecution, mv : Move . move_execution_move(me, mv) or not move_execution_move(me, mv)

replace.to: fact first_move_white : forall pl : Player . first_player(pl) implies exists p : Piece . piece_owner(p, pl) and piece_color(p, White)

strong_issues.issue: References undefined constants Row4 and Row5. Source uses ordinal numbers, not named constants.
strong_issues.suggested_fix: Introduce a row_number : BoardRow -> Integer relation or use explicit predicates for rows 4 and 5, then update the fact to reference them.

drop: fact rows_4_5_empty : forall s : BoardSquare . (square_row(s, Row4) or square_row(s, Row5)) implies not exists p : Piece . piece_square(p, s)

soft_issues.issue: The permission is universally quantified over all players, but the source condition is existential: choice exists only when there are two or more capture possibilities. Universal quantification is acceptable only if tightly conditioned on that existence. As written, the condition also uses move predicates on Capture terms inconsistently, which obscures the intended existential scope.
soft_issues.suggested_fix: Keep the permission form, but make the existential choice situation explicit in the condition using capture predicates only, so the universal over players does not overstate availability of choice.

replace.from:
permission choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_capture_direction
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_move(c1) and is_legal_move(c2) and
        move_direction(c1) != move_direction(c2)
replace.to:
permission choice_capture :
  forall pl : Player .
    action: choose_capture_direction
    condition:
      exists c1 : Capture, c2 : Capture .
        is_legal_capture(c1) and is_legal_capture(c2) and
        c1 != c2

soft_issues.issue: The source says choice exists if there is a choice among kings or men while respecting maximum capture count. The IR uses a universal permission over players with an existential condition, which is acceptable if the existential condition is the real trigger. However, the current condition only states existence of two captures with equal count and misses that the choice is among alternative captures; the existential scope should be made explicit as alternatives rather than a pseudo-general permission.
soft_issues.suggested_fix: Retain the permission but tighten the existential condition to distinct alternative captures with equal maximal count.
